name_en: Emergency braking intention during simulated driving
name_zh: 模拟驾驶紧急制动意图检测
why_new: Braking intention triggered by a sudden traffic event is detected from EEG before the foot moves; no class covers event-triggered intention prediction inside a continuous driving task
neural_readout: Visual P3-like ERP plus pre-movement readiness potential and ERD before brake onset

name_en: Selective attention to one instrument in polyphonic music (music BCI)
name_zh: 复调音乐中的乐器选择性注意（音乐 BCI）
why_new: Deviants embedded in concurrent instrument streams; the attended instrument is decoded from the ERP; PER-AAD is speech-envelope tracking and PER-ODD is a single stream
neural_readout: N2/P3 to deviants in the attended instrument

name_en: Feature-based attention (colour or motion; overlapping frequency-tagged stimuli)
name_zh: 基于特征的注意（颜色或运动；重叠的频率标记刺激）
why_new: Attention selects a feature across the visual field rather than a location; spatially overlapping BCI targets (two coloured dot fields flickering at different rates) depend on it; PER-CVA and PER-CUE are spatial
neural_readout: SSVEP amplitude gain for the attended feature; selection negativity

name_zh: 无关探测刺激工作负荷评估
why_new: Task-irrelevant auditory or visual probes presented during a primary task index spare capacity; a standard passive-BCI workload method; STA-MATB and MEM-NBK record only the primary task
neural_readout: P3 and N1 to probes decrease with primary-task load

name_en: Motor imagery of kinetic and kinematic parameters (force, speed)
name_zh: 运动参数想象（力量、速度）
why_new: Same limb throughout; imagery differs in force level or speed, so the decoding target is a movement parameter rather than a body part; MOT-MI classes are body-part sets
neural_readout: Graded mu/beta ERD and MRCP amplitude with imagined force or speed

name_zh: 注视选择意图（眼–脑接口）
why_new: Separates intentional from spontaneous fixations in gaze control (the Midas-touch problem; Shishkin et al. 2016, doi 10.3389/fnins.2016.00528); LAN-READ uses fixation-related potentials only for reading
neural_readout: Fixation-related negativity (expectancy, SPN-like) over parieto-occipital sites during intentional dwells

name_en: Inattentional deafness to auditory alarms under load
name_zh: 高负荷下的非注意聋（听觉警报漏报）
why_new: Auditory alarms missed during a demanding visual task (flight, driving); auditory counterpart of PER-IB and a passive-BCI detection target
neural_readout: Reduced N1 and P3 to unattended alarm sounds

name_zh: 吞咽（执行与想象）
why_new: Oropharyngeal action not covered by limb, finger or speech classes; motor imagery of swallowing is used in dysphagia-rehabilitation BCI
neural_readout: Sensorimotor ERD over lateral motor cortex; BOLD in precentral gyrus and insula

name_zh: 视觉周边抑制
why_new: Centre-surround contrast interaction with flickering centre and annulus (task in the Healthy Brain Network EEG releases on OpenNeuro); SSR-SSVEP has no surround manipulation
neural_readout: SSVEP amplitude reduced by a high-contrast surround

name_en: Tonic pain (cold pressor, capsaicin, sustained heat)
name_zh: 持续性疼痛（冷加压、辣椒素、持续热刺激）
why_new: Minutes-long ongoing pain rather than phasic evoked responses (PER-LEP) or periodic stimulation (SSR-NSSEP); used for objective pain-state decoding
neural_readout: Prefrontal gamma increase and alpha suppression; insula/ACC BOLD

name_zh: 成瘾物质与食物线索反应
why_new: Craving-related cues versus neutral cues in users or hungry participants; target of craving neurofeedback; EMO-IAPS uses normative affective pictures
neural_readout: Enhanced P3/LPP to cues; ventral striatum and OFC BOLD

name_zh: 跨通道选择性注意
why_new: Attend vision or audition within bimodal streams; existing attention classes work inside one modality
neural_readout: Posterior alpha increase when attending audition; Nd attention effect

name_en: Vibrotactile frequency discrimination and working memory
name_zh: 振动触觉频率辨别与工作记忆
why_new: Two-interval comparison of flutter frequencies; parametric (quantity) working memory rather than item recognition
neural_readout: Parametric prefrontal beta power during retention; SEP

name_zh: 自生刺激的感觉衰减
why_new: Tones or touches triggered by the participant's own button press versus external triggering; PER-OMIT records omissions and LAN-SIS covers speech only
neural_readout: N1/P2 suppression for self-generated sounds

name_zh: 指令性欺骗（说谎与说真话）
why_new: Participants deliberately lie or tell the truth about facts or intentions; MEM-CIT probes concealed memories, not the act of lying
neural_readout: DLPFC/ACC BOLD; N2 and P3 differences for deceptive responses

name_zh: 双耳拍频刺激
why_new: Dichotic carriers with a small frequency offset, so the beat exists only centrally; SSR-ASSR uses physically modulated tones
neural_readout: Spectral power at the beat frequency (a systematic review reports inconsistent entrainment)

name_zh: 挫折诱发
why_new: Blocked goals, unexpected delays or rigged failures in tasks and games; an affective-BCI label distinct from psychosocial stress (EMO-STRESS)
neural_readout: Frontal alpha asymmetry and frontal theta; FRN

name_zh: 体感失匹配负波
why_new: Standard-deviant or roving vibrotactile/electrical streams; tactile analogue of PER-MMN and PER-VMMN (may become a PER-MMN concrete paradigm if D-060 is confirmed)
neural_readout: sMMN at 100-250 ms over somatosensory cortex

name_zh: 电子游戏任务
why_new: Interactive game play (Space Fortress, commercial games) for engagement and workload estimation; STA-ENG covers passive video and classroom learning
neural_readout: Frontal theta and parietal alpha workload indices

name_zh: 机械触觉诱发电位
why_new: Air-puff, brush or tap stimulation without current; STM-SEP is electrical median-nerve stimulation
neural_readout: P50/N140 tactile ERP; somatosensory BOLD

name_zh: 时距加工（时距复制与二分）
why_new: Encoding and judging durations without trial feedback; ERR-TE is feedback-based learning and PER-TIME is temporal order
neural_readout: CNV amplitude scales with duration; beta power

name_zh: 场景知觉（场景选择性定位）
why_new: Scenes versus objects and faces; PER-CAT is object-category decoding; the scene-perception construct was approved under D-079 but no class uses it
neural_readout: PPA/OPA/RSC BOLD; scene-selective P2

name_en: Placebo analgesia and expectancy modulation of pain
name_zh: 安慰剂镇痛与预期对疼痛的调制
why_new: Cues or inert treatments change expected pain; PER-LEP has no expectation manipulation
neural_readout: Reduced LEP N2-P2; ACC, insula and DLPFC BOLD

name_zh: 呼吸激发（过度换气、屏气）
why_new: Hyperventilation is a standard clinical-EEG activation procedure and breath-hold a standard fMRI cerebrovascular-reactivity test; no state class covers respiratory challenge
neural_readout: EEG slowing during hyperventilation; BOLD reactivity to breath-hold

name_zh: 审美欣赏
why_new: Beauty or liking ratings of artworks, faces or music; EMO-IAPS uses valence/arousal-normed pictures
neural_readout: Medial OFC BOLD; LPP

name_zh: 听觉规律浮现（随机到规律序列）
why_new: Transitions from random to repeating tone patterns without deviants; MMN and local-global paradigms rely on deviance
neural_readout: Sustained potential rising at regularity onset (MEG/EEG)

name_zh: 图形–背景分离
why_new: Texture-defined figures or stochastic figure-ground tone clouds; PER-STREAM covers sequential streaming and PER-IC illusory contours
neural_readout: Texture-segregation VEP; figure-related negativity

name_zh: 知觉闭合（碎片图与双色图）
why_new: Recognition emerging from incomplete images; PER-CAT uses intact objects
neural_readout: Closure negativity (Ncl); LOC BOLD

name_zh: 眨眼条件化
why_new: Delay or trace conditioning of a tone with an air puff; cerebellar associative learning; EMO-FC is fear conditioning
neural_readout: Cerebellar BOLD; CS-evoked EEG changes with learning

name_zh: 范畴学习（原型扭曲、规则型）
why_new: Learning categories from exemplars such as dot-pattern prototypes; ERR-PCL is probabilistic cue-outcome learning
neural_readout: Occipital BOLD reduction for prototypes; FRN in feedback-based learning

name_zh: 负启动
why_new: Responding to a previously ignored distractor is slowed; measures distractor inhibition across trials rather than within-trial conflict
neural_readout: N2 and P3 modulation on ignored-repetition trials

name_zh: 层级规则学习
why_new: Rules nested at several levels of abstraction; CTL-SW switches between flat task sets
neural_readout: Rostro-caudal lateral PFC BOLD gradient

name_zh: 决策前信息采样（珠子任务）
why_new: Participants decide how much evidence to sample before committing (jumping to conclusions); CTL-PDM presents fixed evidence
neural_readout: Parietal and insular BOLD; P3 to each draw

name_zh: 好奇心驱动的信息寻求
why_new: Information without instrumental value (trivia answers, outcome previews); not reward-feedback learning
neural_readout: Striatal and midbrain BOLD; reward-positivity-like response to information

name_zh: 计数（速算与点数）
why_new: Rapid enumeration of small dot sets versus serial counting; CTL-NUM is symbolic magnitude comparison
neural_readout: N2pc and CDA saturating at the subitizing range

name_zh: 线段二等分与地标判断
why_new: Judging pre-bisected lines; spatial-attention asymmetry (pseudoneglect)
neural_readout: Right-parietal BOLD; early N1 asymmetry

name_zh: 间隙检测
why_new: Silent gaps in noise test temporal resolution of hearing; PER-ACC covers spectral change
neural_readout: Gap-evoked N1-P2

name_en: Pitch perception (missing fundamental, iterated rippled noise)
name_zh: 音高知觉（缺失基频、迭代波纹噪声）
why_new: Pitch derived from harmonic structure; SSR-FFR tracks stimulus periodicity without a perceptual pitch contrast
neural_readout: Pitch onset response; lateral Heschl's gyrus BOLD

name_zh: 面孔特质判断（可信度、支配性）
why_new: First-impression judgements from faces; SOC-RACE covers group membership
neural_readout: Amygdala BOLD scaling with untrustworthiness; early face ERP

name_zh: 竞争性策略博弈（猜硬币）
why_new: Zero-sum mixed-strategy games; SOC-TRUST and SOC-PGG are cooperation games
neural_readout: FRN to wins and losses; ACC/DLPFC BOLD

name_zh: 反应性攻击（Taylor 攻击、点数扣除范式）
why_new: Provocation and retaliation against an opponent; SOC-UG measures rejection of unfair offers
neural_readout: Frontal alpha asymmetry; FRN; dACC/amygdala BOLD

name_zh: 近因判断（时间顺序记忆）
why_new: Which of two items appeared more recently in a list; MEM-SRC covers source context
neural_readout: Prefrontal BOLD; old/new ERP modulation

name_zh: 主动与被动回避学习
why_new: Learning to avoid aversive outcomes by acting or withholding; ERR-INST is mainly appetitive
neural_readout: Striatal BOLD; FRN for avoided versus received punishment

name_zh: Hayling 句子补全
why_new: Suppressing the prepotent sentence ending; verbal response inhibition
neural_readout: Left IFG BOLD

name_zh: 工具使用哑剧（运用）
why_new: Pantomimed tool use without the object; apraxia assessment; MOT-GRASP uses real objects
neural_readout: Left parieto-premotor BOLD; mu ERD

name_zh: 盲文阅读
why_new: Tactile reading in blind readers (cross-modal plasticity); LAN-VWFA is visual
neural_readout: Occipital and VWFA BOLD

name_zh: 语篇连贯
why_new: Coherent versus incoherent multi-sentence texts; LAN-N400 and LAN-SC work within single sentences
neural_readout: N400 to discourse-incongruent words

name_zh: 言语跟读
why_new: Repeating heard speech with minimal delay, coupling perception and production in real time
neural_readout: Speech-motor BOLD; speech-envelope tracking

name_zh: 冷热栅错觉
why_new: Interlaced warm and cool bars evoke a burning sensation
neural_readout: ACC BOLD

name_zh: 非痛性温度刺激
why_new: Warm or cool non-painful contact stimuli; PER-LEP is nociceptive
neural_readout: Warm/cool evoked potentials; insular BOLD

name_zh: 膀胱充盈（内脏内感受）
why_new: Visceral interoception during controlled filling; PER-HBD covers cardiac interoception
neural_readout: PAG, insula and ACC BOLD

name_zh: 几何视错觉（缪勒–莱尔错觉）
why_new: Size and length illusions; PER-IC covers illusory contours
neural_readout: Lateral occipital BOLD; early VEP modulation

name_zh: 轮廓整合
why_new: Detecting paths of aligned Gabor elements in noise
neural_readout: Occipital ERP at about 150-250 ms; V1/V2 and LOC BOLD

name_zh: 针刺刺激
why_new: Needle manipulation at acupoints versus sham; STM-TAVNS is electrical
neural_readout: Limbic BOLD deactivation; EEG alpha changes
